short_title: Screen-wide signal-level colocalization and model QC
mandatory_caveat: Combinations sharing a PBC locus are not independent; relaxed priors do not upgrade the locked strict-prior class; non-convergent estimates are not inferential.

short_title: Ten-locus local signed-LD and SuSiE QC
mandatory_caveat: Signed LD can be negative while absolute credible-set purity is high; 1000G EUR is external reference LD, not discovery-study-specific LD.
Repeated gene-cell combinations at one locus are correlated evidence; signal sharing does not establish a causal transcript or druggability.

short_title: TYK2 LD bootstrap and population sensitivity
mandatory_caveat: Intervals propagate reference-LD uncertainty only; 1000G FIN is not FinnGen study-specific signed LD.
Controls are peritumoral hemangioma surgical liver, not healthy-volunteer biopsy tissue.
Composition is descriptive; no differential-abundance claim. The locked archive contained no integrated UMAP coordinates for this supplementary analysis.
No IL12RB2 contrast passes transcriptome-wide FDR 0.05; sensitivity analyses are not independent replications.
Two PBC donors and uneven normal immune-cell coverage support external directional evidence, not confirmatory differential expression.
Bulk results support direction and heterogeneity, not a diagnostic or prognostic biomarker.
Age and recruitment source are structurally confounded with disease; absence from FDR-only lists is not effect reversal.
